original_fields.Title: Description family and household projections
original_fields.Content: Family and household projections indicate the future trends in the size and broad types of families and households usually living in New Zealand, including 16 regional council areas (regions), 67 territorial authority areas (TAs), and 21 Auckland local board areas (ALBs).
